answer.location_description: Small 3x3 square near the top-left corner of the image, at rows 1-3 and columns 1-3.
answer.mechanism: Many first-layer units carry a strong, uniform 3x3 block of weights on rows 1-3, cols 1-3 that stands apart from the noise-level weights around it. Two groups use this block in opposite ways. (1) Units 1, 7, 11, 12, 14, 16 and 19 are large-blob detectors (a positive ring or disk around the centre), and their corner weights are large and positive (+43 to +99). (2) Units 3, 5, 8, 10, 17, 20, 23, 25, 30 and 31 are small-blob detectors (negative weights on the mid-radius ring, positive on the background), and their corner weights are large and negative (about -30 to -99). In layer 2, the units with positive output weights, u13 (+99) and u8 (+65), take positive input from the first group and negative input from the second. The units with negative output weights, u3 (-94), u9 (-98) and u12 (-72), do the reverse. A bright corner patch therefore drives the logit positive through both pathways at once.
answer.evidence: Corner block rows 1-3, cols 1-3: unit 1 = 66, 59, 98 / 59, 96, 71 / 70, 88, 66. Unit 16 = 83, 99, 97 ... and units 7, 11, 12, 14, 19 are similar. Unit 3 = -91, -78, -84 / -84, -68, -58 / -77, -94, -71. Units 5, 8, 17, 20, 23, 25, 31 are similarly strongly negative, and units 10 and 30 more moderately so (about -30 to -74). Elsewhere in the same units, pixels outside the blob region have weights of only about ±30, so the block is not part of a blob template. Layer-2 weights: u13 gets +87 from unit 7, +78 from unit 19, +68 from unit 14 and +63 from unit 12, and -92 from unit 17, -87 from unit 25 and -78 from unit 5. u3 gets +87 from units 17 and 25 and +85 from unit 23, and -93 from unit 14 and -81 from unit 16. Output weights: u13 = +99, u8 = +65, u3 = -94, u9 = -98, u12 = -72.
answer.main_feature: Blob size is judged from brightness on an annulus around the centre (radius about 4-7 pixels). Units with positive weights on the ring signal a large blob. Units with a negative ring and positive background signal a small blob, since they stay active only when the ring is dark.
